full_judgment: 4. Mr Muhammad Nawab Ali, the learned Advocate-on-Record appearing on behalf of the appellant submits that the law does not permit imposition of a sentence of rigorous imprisonment of twenty years. The maximum sentence that could be imposed, other than sentence for imprisonment for life, would be a sentence of imprisonment up to ten years. He submits that, therefore, the sentence imposed by the High Court Division is illegal.
